name: What is the process for a whole house remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for a whole house remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our whole house remodel process typically begins with an initial consultation to discuss your vision and budget. This is followed by design and planning, where architectural plans, material selections, and a detailed scope of work are finalized. Once permits are secured, the construction phase begins, involving demolition, framing, utility installations, insulation, drywall, and finish work. Throughout the project, regular communication ensures you are updated on progress. The remodel concludes with a final walkthrough and project completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The remodel process involves consultation, design and planning, permit acquisition, construction, and a final walkthrough.
